Vladimir Putin Praises Elon Musk as a 'Real Genius' Amid Discussions on Satellite Coordination

29 Oct 2026, 04:25 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Business Desk · Source: www.bbc.co.uk

Key takeawaysRussian President Vladimir Putin has described Elon Musk as a "real genius" following revelations that the Russian government is in close contact with the SpaceX founder regarding satellite technology. The remarks were made on Wednesday during the Russia-Africa Summit i

Russian President Vladimir Putin has described Elon Musk as a "real genius" following revelations that the Russian government is in close contact with the SpaceX founder regarding satellite technology. The remarks were made on Wednesday during the Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow, where discussions centered on Russia's burgeoning satellite internet initiative, known as Rassvet.

Putin emphasized the necessity of maintaining communication with Musk to ensure that Russia's Rassvet constellation and SpaceX’s Starlink network do not interfere with one another in orbit. "We and our American partners value this mutually, and despite all the political questions, we are working hard," Putin stated, according to a BBC translation of his remarks. SpaceX did not respond to requests for comment regarding the discussions.

Scale and Infrastructure Differences

The technological capabilities and deployment scales of the two satellite networks differ significantly. According to company data, SpaceX's Starlink has launched approximately 13,000 satellites to provide global broadband coverage. In contrast, independent online satellite trackers indicate that Russia's Rassvet project currently operates only a couple of dozen satellites. The Russian Embassy in South Africa described Rassvet as the nation's alternative to Starlink, noting that the initiative represents the country's initial steps in expanding space-based internet infrastructure.

Geopolitical Context and Technological Impact

The high-level acknowledgment of Musk comes amid shifting diplomatic dynamics between Washington and Moscow. Starlink technology has played a critical role in providing communications infrastructure in Ukraine following Russia's full-scale invasion, though recent reports highlighted connectivity disruptions that Musk acknowledged were intentionally implemented by SpaceX. Meanwhile, diplomatic and economic interactions between the United States and Russia have seen recent developments, including U.S. policy adjustments regarding certain sanctions and diesel imports.

Practical Implications and Verification

For readers seeking to understand the scope and technical realities of these developments, several verified facts and open questions remain important to consider:

  • Confirmed Details: Russian President Vladimir Putin publicly praised Elon Musk during the Russia-Africa Summit, confirming ongoing communications regarding orbital coordination between Starlink and the Rassvet project.
  • Operational Scale: A substantial disparity exists between the two satellite networks, with Starlink operating thousands of spacecraft compared to a much smaller number deployed for Rassvet.
  • Uncertainties: Specific technical details, formal agreements, or the exact frequency of communications between SpaceX leadership and Russian officials have not been independently detailed beyond official statements.
  • How to Verify: Readers can review the original reporting and context directly via the [BBC News coverage](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c63djl148n3eo), and consult public orbital tracking registries to monitor satellite deployment statistics.
